description: This file defines a Data Access Object (DAO) class named PerformanceReviewDao in the OrangeHRM system. It manages database operations related to performance reviews, including creating, updating, retrieving, and deleting performance review records, and handling reviewers and KPIs associated with those reviews. It incorporates various methods to support complex querying, transaction management, and interaction with related entity classes such as Employee, Reviewer, Kpi, and PerformanceReview.

classes.name: PerformanceReviewDao
classes.description: A DAO class responsible for managing database interactions related to performance reviews in the OrangeHRM system, including CRUD operations, querying, and handling associated entities like reviewers and KPIs.

methods.name: getEmployeeSupervisorList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Employee entities serving as supervisors for a specified employee based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: getEmployeeSupervisorCount
methods.description: Returns the count of supervisor relationships matching the search filter parameters.

methods.name: createReview
methods.description: Creates a new PerformanceReview record, associating it with reviewer entities, within a database transaction.

methods.name: getEditableReviewById
methods.description: Fetches a performance review by ID only if its status is inactive, implying it can be edited.

methods.name: getPerformanceReviewById
methods.description: Retrieves a performance review entity by its ID.

methods.name: getPerformanceReviewList
methods.description: Returns a list of performance reviews based on specified search filters.

methods.name: getPerformanceReviewCount
methods.description: Returns the count of performance reviews matching given search criteria.

methods.name: getPerformanceSelfReviewStatus
methods.description: Determines and returns the status of the self-review component of a performance review.

methods.name: updateReview
methods.description: Updates an existing performance review record and its associated reviewers within a transaction.

methods.name: deletePerformanceReviewReviewers
methods.description: Deletes reviewer records linked to a specific performance review.

methods.name: getSupervisorRecord
methods.description: Retrieves supervisor-report relationships between two employees.

methods.name: getReviewKPI
methods.description: Fetches KPI entities associated with a particular performance review.

methods.name: getPerformanceSelfReviewer
methods.description: Retrieves the reviewer entity representing the employee's own review role for a given performance review.

methods.name: deletePerformanceReviews
methods.description: Deletes multiple performance reviews by their IDs.

methods.name: getReviewById
methods.description: Fetches a performance review entity by its ID.

methods.name: getExistingPerformanceReviewIds
methods.description: Returns IDs of performance reviews that exist within a given list of IDs.

methods.name: getKpisForReview
methods.description: Retrieves KPIs relevant for a specific review based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getKpisForReviewCount
methods.description: Counts KPIs matching review filter parameters.

methods.name: savePerformanceReview
methods.description: Persists a performance review entity to the database.

methods.name: setReviewerStatusToCompleted
methods.description: Marks all reviewers associated with a review as 'completed'.

methods.name: getReviewIdsForSupervisorReviewer
methods.description: Fetches all review IDs assigned to a supervisor for review, filtering out inactive or purged reviews.

methods.name: getReviewIdList
methods.description: Retrieves list of active (non-purged) performance review IDs.

methods.name: getSelfReviewIds
methods.description: Retrieves IDs of self-reviews for a given employee, optionally filtering by statuses.

methods.name: getReviewerRating
methods.description: Fetches reviewer ratings for a supervisor evaluation, filtered by reviewer group.

methods.name: getReviewerRatingCount
methods.description: Counts reviewer ratings for a supervisor evaluation, filtered by reviewer group.

methods.name: getKpiIdsForReviewId
methods.description: Fetches KPI IDs associated with a specific review ID.

methods.name: getKpiIdsForJobTitleId
methods.description: Retrieves KPI IDs linked to a specific job title.

methods.name: saveAndUpdateReviewerRatings
methods.description: Saves or updates a batch of reviewer rating entities, handling persistence efficiently.

methods.name: getReviewerRecord
methods.description: Retrieves the reviewer record for a specific review and reviewer group.

methods.name: updateReviewerStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of reviewers in a specific review group.

methods.name: updateReviewerComment
methods.description: Updates the comment field for reviewers in a specific review group.
